thread:
Priya: Hey team — CS reported tenants seeing v2 headers but billed for v1. We have no clear console affordance for "routing parity" and customers are confused.
Arjun: Oof. Which tenant/time?
Priya: tenant-900, 22:10-22:18 UTC. Logs show `x-api-version:2` in requests, `routed_version:1` downstream. fallback_reason labels include capacity and quantize_fail.
telemetry-bot: spike: implicit_route_switch{tenant="tenant-900"} +52 in 8m.
Marta: We need a two-part approach: telemetry + lightweight console signal. Telemetry: emit `version_routing_event{tenant,route,incoming_version,routed_version,reason}`. Console: a compact "parity pill" per-route showing percent requests honoring requested version.
Priya: Also important: annotate billing lines with routed_version for that invoice window so customers see costs match actual serving.
Arjun: For alerts, start probe-mode: tenant-level rule e.g.
```
sum by (tenant) (increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])) > 10 and
increase(implicit_route_switch[10m]) > 2 * median_over_time(increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])[7d:1m])
```
Combine with header mismatches to reduce false positives.
Marta: UX: pill states — gray (>=98% parity), amber (probe), orange (investigate), red (sustained instability). Click opens drilldown with last 200 requests: cols = ts, incoming_version, routed_version, model_hash, fallback_reason, trace_link.
Priya: Ops ask: when probe alert fires include prescriptive steps: view autoscaler events, last deploys, and a pin command example `rwctl pin --tenant tenant-900 --route /chat --ver v2 --ttl 30m`.
Arjun: We'll also compute a `stability_score` (decay-weighted) so short spikes don't dominate. Something like `stability = sum(e^{-age/τ} * fallback_event)` aggregated per-route.
telemetry-bot: note: proposed metric `version_routing_event` added to catalog (dry-run).
Marta: To prioritize semantic endpoints, add a route severity weight (embeddings=10, rerank=5, chat=1). Compute `weighted_parity_drop` and alert on that to surface higher-risk breakages first.
Priya: Audit event: emit `silent_downgrade` when tenant >20 downgrades in 10m, include sample request IDs and trace links for CS. Also add `downgrade_initiator` label (autoscaler|quantize|manual).
Arjun: Circuit-breaker thought: avoid rapidly re-downgrading same client stream. If a client IP had a downgrade in last 2m, suppress additional silent downgrades for that stream unless no v2 capacity exists for >1m. Needs careful testing.
Marta: Bonus: synthetic golden probes — periodic small test requests against v2 pools to detect silent semantic regressions. Use public synthetic inputs or opt-in customer testsets.
infra-bot: FYI: billing annotation feature flagged.
Priya: Plan: 1) define `version_routing_event` schema + billing tag 2) add stability_score & weighted metric in telemetry 3) build parity pill + drilldown UI (probe-only) 4) add probe-mode alert rules for 48-72h 5) emit audit events + include runbook links in alerts 6) iterate thresholds and consider circuit-breaker after data.
Arjun: I'll prototype Prom rules and a Graf panel. Marta, can you mock the pill + drilldown? Priya will draft CS runbook.
Marta: On it. Let's aim for a weekend probe run and reconvene Monday to review signals.
